messages:
Alice S.: Heads-up — enterprise customer (acme-corp) reports huge p99 spikes and auth failures. They say requests are sometimes routed to eu-west-1 and then immediately to us-east-1, causing 400–500ms extra latency and a handful of auth 401s when tokens expire during retry. Ticket 987654.

Dave (SDK): Can you paste a sample trace or headers? Are they using hedged requests or custom retry/backoff?

Alice S.: Here's trimmed trace from their app (timestamps relative):
```
[00:00.000] -> POST /v1/generate region=us-west-2 request_id=abc123 timeout=60ms
[00:00.061] client retry (hedged) -> POST /v1/generate region=eu-west-1 request_id=def456
[00:00.150] backend served region=eu-west-1 latency=85ms status=200
[00:00.160] backend served region=us-west-2 latency=120ms status=200
```
They get two hits for same logical request. SDK is configured with hedged=true, initial_timeout_ms=50, max_attempts=2. Some responses arrive back-of-order.

Bob (Eng Runtime): That looks like the hedged path is firing a concurrent request to a fallback region after initial timeout. If the first request is still inflight but slower, we can see double backend calls. That's expected but we shouldn't get 401s unless token TTLs are very short or token refresh races.

Carol (Eng-ML): Also seeing reports that tokens are rotated on refresh and the SDK is re-sending with new token to second attempt while first attempt had old token — could produce transient 401s in logs and billing double-count.

Dave (SDK): Repro idea: run this small script with hedged enabled and a tiny timeout to force overlap. Use the SDK env override to route primary->us-west-2, fallback->eu-west-1.

Alice S.: Repro steps I used (shared with customer):
1) SDK v2.3.1 with: hedgedRequests=true, initialTimeoutMs=40, maxHedgeBackoffMs=200
2) Simulate backend slowdown on us-west-2 to 120ms
3) Run 1000 requests concurrently
Code snippet:
```
// node repro.js
const r = new RedwoodSDK({ hedgedRequests: true, initialTimeoutMs: 40, routes: ['us-west-2','eu-west-1'] });
await Promise.all(Array.from({length:1000}).map(()=> r.generate({prompt:'x'.repeat(200)})));
```
Observed: ~8% requests hit both regions, ~0.5% 401s, p99 up by 250ms.

Bob (Eng Runtime): Thanks. Short term: set hedgedRequests=false for that tenant and increase initialTimeoutMs to 200ms. Long term: runtime should avoid duplicate billing attribution and we should add sticky token pinning to hedged attempts — i.e., copy the exact Authorization header across retries.

Dave (SDK): Agree. We should also default hedgedRequests to off for token-based auth until SDK can guarantee token reuse. I'll open PR to 1) copy auth header to duplicate attempts 2) add opt-in flag hedgedCopyAuth=true.

Carol (Eng-ML): Also add telemetry: attach original request_id to all hedged attempts so logs can de-dupe and billing can be aware. That's low-risk.

Alice S.: I'm going to apply customer mitigation now (disable hedging on tenant) and escalate to AM. Can you label issue: region-hedge-auth? @Dave (SDK) please link PR to ticket 987654.

Dave (SDK): On it. I'll target a hotfix branch and include unit tests. ETA ~4h.

incident-bot: deploy started for sdk-hotfix/hedge-auth-copy by dave — build 4521

Alice S.: Thanks team — I'll update the customer. :thumbsup:
